purpose: Compile validated CSD-010 frame direction into deterministic provider-neutral visual production specifications without losing narrative, identity, perception, emotional or continuity intent.
core_principle: Compilation changes representation, never meaning. Every production field must be traceable to an approved upstream scene decision.
identity_compilation_rules: Visual locks must be copied by identifier, not rewritten by the compiler.
Performance state may change while identity remains unchanged.
Costume, anatomy, face, voice and canonical props remain locked unless an upstream scene state explicitly authorizes a continuity change.
Unknown visual details must not be invented as canonical identity.
perception_compilation_rules: Perspective determines attention and camera intent.
Knowledge boundaries determine what may be visually revealed through subjective framing.
Belief influences interpretation and performance, not physical reality.
Blind spots may be encoded through framing, occlusion, focus, negative space or omission.
Audience-only information must remain explicitly marked.
A character's internal state may be expressed visually only through supported performance cues.
continuity_compilation_rules: Preserve spatial relationships from the canonical scene.
Preserve temporal state and scene phase.
Carry CSD-006 emotional consequences into performance.
Carry CSD-007 information constraints into subjective framing.
Carry CSD-008 perception constraints into attention and composition.
Carry CSD-009 validation fingerprint into production lineage.
F01 trusted references may be inherited only through explicit reference lineage.
Compiler must not promote derived storyboard imagery to independent asset status.

pass_conditions: every field traceable to upstream input or explicit production default

visual_compilation.frame_intent: Ravana studies Rama's unchanged composure after choosing restraint.
visual_compilation.camera: subjective medium-close perspective aligned to Ravana's attention
visual_compilation.composition: Rama remains visually stable while Ravana's attention controls emphasis
visual_compilation.lighting: preserve established scene lighting; no emotional lighting invention
negative_constraints: no omniscient reveal of Rama's thoughts
